study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Beta-Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial
reason: The prospective nested case-control analysis examines incident prostate cancer without reporting an aggressive subtype. The abstract reports 205 prostate cancer cases, but the prostate-specific number of controls and therefore the prostate analytic sample size are not explicitly stated.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For prostate cancer, mean serum concentrations were lower in cases for all of the nutrients except alpha-carotene. Only for alpha-tocopherol (P(trend) = 0.04) were the findings statistically significant.
estimate_classifications.reason: The vitamin E row corresponds to serum alpha-tocopherol and overall incident prostate cancer, not aggressive disease.
